requirements.requirement: /tmp mounted with noexec, nosuid, nodev applied
requirements.summary: Baseline showed /tmp not separately mounted (cmd-aecb88044c714e99). After adding fstab entry and mounting, findmnt confirms /tmp shows rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec (cmd-27646ee9520d4bad), and a functional exec test on a chmod+x script in /tmp was blocked with 'Permission denied' (cmd-27646ee9520d4bad).

requirements.requirement: /dev/shm mounted with noexec, nosuid, nodev applied
requirements.summary: Baseline showed /dev/shm with only nosuid,nodev (missing noexec) (cmd-aecb88044c714e99). After remount, findmnt confirms /dev/shm shows rw,nosuid,nodev,noexec (cmd-27646ee9520d4bad), with a functional exec test also blocked by Permission denied.

fstab entries for tmpfs /tmp and tmpfs /dev/shm with defaults,noexec,nosuid,nodev were confirmed present pre-restart (cmd-2fb0d4f8341b4fad). A reboot was issued (cmd-d565ed1c75e749e7), boot_id changed from 636556ce... to a1751102... confirming an actual reboot occurred, and post-reboot findmnt shows both /tmp and /dev/shm retain nosuid,nodev,noexec with functional exec tests again blocked (cmd-678d44e2aece41ff). This directly demonstrates the pre-restart healthy baseline, the disruption, and the recovered hardened state.

overall_summary: The executor added persistent fstab entries and live-applied noexec,nosuid,nodev to both /tmp and /dev/shm on node1, verified via findmnt and functional exec-blocking tests, then performed an actual reboot (proven by a changed boot_id) and re-verified the hardened options and blocked-exec behavior survived. All three material outcomes are directly and coherently satisfied with pre/post evidence.
limitations: The task-required reboot doubles as the only node-restart evidence collected; no separate provider-wide restart protocol evidence beyond this single-node reboot was included, but node1 is the only managed node so this is not a gap for this topology.

operational_hygiene.summary: All state-changing commands map clearly to task outcomes: fstab was backed up before editing (cmd-27646ee9520d4bad), the two fstab entries added were exactly the required options, /tmp mount and /dev/shm remount applied the change live, and the temporary test scripts/error files created in /tmp and /dev/shm for functional verification were removed in the same command (cmd-27646ee9520d4bad, cmd-678d44e2aece41ff), leaving no residue — confirmed by the after_executor temporary-files snapshot showing only systemd-private dirs tied to the new boot, not leftover test artifacts. The single reboot (cmd-d565ed1c75e749e7) was a necessary, expected, single-node action directly required by the persistence requirement. No failed services, unsafe exposure, or unrelated mutations were observed.
